mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in CPIAUCSL indicates accelerating inflation, which increases the probability of central bank tightening and reduces equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of months with positive month-over-month CPIAUCSL change, or Rank IC over last 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 0.25% per annum, it signals a shift toward monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS exceeding 0.25% is followed by positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or Rank IC over last 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in unemployment rate exceeding 0.1 percentage points combined with a monthly payroll growth below 100,000 jobs indicates a labor market recovery that is insufficient to support robust corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE monthly change < -0.1 and PAYEMS monthly change < 100
failure_condition: In more than 50% of instances meeting the trigger condition, S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns, or Rank IC over last 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by UNRATE < 6.0% and GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% annually), a decline in monthly housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening consumer demand and impending economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regime, HOUST decline is followed by positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC over last 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of months with positive month-over-month PAYEMS change, S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns, or Rank IC over last 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (index, 2017=100), it signals a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO below 100 is followed by positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or Rank IC over last 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery regime (defined by UNRATE > 7.0% and GDPC1 growth rate > 1.0% annually), a strong monthly increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 0.5% signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In post-recession recovery regime, RSAFS growth above 0.5% is followed by negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC over last 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly retail sales growth exceeding 0.5% (RSAFS) combined with a federal funds rate that does not decline (FEDFUNDS monthly change >= 0) indicates economic expansion without monetary accommodation, increasing the risk of policy-induced slowdown and resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS monthly change > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS monthly change >= 0
failure_condition: In more than 50% of instances meeting the trigger condition, S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns, or Rank IC over last 5 years is below 0.03.
